help.title: MiQ Bot help
help.mention: Reply to a message and mention the bot to turn it into a quote image, or use the "Quote" entry in a message's right-click (or ⋯) menu.
help.optionsTitle: Options (combine freely after the mention, e.g. `@MiQ color new font=pop`) — each has an opposite, to override a saved default back for one message
help.optionFlip: `flip` (or `right`) / `unflip` (or `left`) — avatar on the right, or back on the left (side layout only)
help.optionNew: `new` / `side` (or `classic`) — portrait layout (avatar full-bleed, quote over the bottom) or the regular side-by-side layout
help.optionTheme: `theme=<alias>` — pick a background color (see Color themes below)
help.fakequoteHint: `/fakequote author: message: options:` makes up a quote in someone else's name — they can block this for themselves with `/settings set`.
help.contextMenuHint: Right-click (or long-press, or the ⋯ menu) any message and choose "Quote" to do the same without typing a mention.
help.settingsHint: Save your own defaults with `/settings set`, this server's with `/server-settings set` (Manage Server), or clear either with the matching `reset` command.
